The authors attributed this to aluminium exposure, but the study’s design and conclusions have been criticised.10-12 An inquiry by the UK DoH13 does not anticipate that exposure to aluminium from this incident would have caused long-term health problems in people who were adults or toddlers at the time, although this possibility should be explored further in those who were bottle-fed infants (i.e. below one year of age) at that time.
